title: MolSC: Leveraging Substituent Contributions to Enhance Fine-grained Molecular Understanding in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.23073v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in natural language processing have led to molecular Large Language Models (LLMs) with strong performance across diverse chemistry tasks. However, they still struggle to capture fine-grained structure-property relationships, particularly how small, localized modifications alter a molecule's behavior. To address this limitation, we introduce MolSC, a dataset of substituent contributions, defined as property changes induced by attaching specific substituents to molecular scaffolds. Curated from manually annotated bioactivity records, MolSC spans structural-alert liability, target-specific bioactivity, and physicochemical descriptors, and contains 181K substituent-level examples for training. We further propose MolSC-Bench, a held-out evaluation benchmark of 1,541 examples disjoint from MolSC at the scaffold, substituent, and molecule levels. translated_title: MolSC：利用取代基贡献增强大语言模型的细粒度分子理解
translated_abstract: 自然语言处理的最新进展催生了在多种化学任务中表现优异的分子大语言模型（LLMs）。然而，这些模型仍难以捕捉细粒度的结构-性质关系，尤其是微小的局部修饰如何改变分子的行为。为解决这一局限，我们提出了MolSC，一个取代基贡献数据集，其定义为将特定取代基连接到分子骨架上所引起的性质变化。MolSC从人工标注的生物活性记录中整理而来，涵盖结构性警示风险、靶点特异性生物活性以及理化描述符，包含181K个取代基级别的训练样本。我们进一步提出了MolSC-Bench，一个包含1,541个样本的留出评估基准，其在骨架、取代基和分子三个层面均与MolSC不重叠。我们的实验表明，现有的分子大语言模型和强大的专有模型……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了包含18.1万取代基级样本的取代基贡献数据集MolSC，以及与训练数据在骨架、取代基和分子层面均不重叠的评估基准MolSC-Bench，以增强大语言模型对分子细粒度结构-性质关系的理解。
en_tdlr: We introduce MolSC, a dataset of 181K substituent-level examples capturing property changes induced by attaching substituents to molecular scaffolds, together with MolSC-Bench, a disjoint evaluation benchmark, to enhance LLMs' fine-grained molecular understanding.
